propositions: On platforms without /proc (macOS), _process_start_time returns None, making the recycled-pid discriminator unsatisfiable and causing dead holders with recycled pids to be judged fresh indefinitely
A live-pid verdict without start-time confirmation is unqualified and must fall back to the 1-hour ceiling to bound orphan lock reclamation

The dual-leg invariant (fcntl held for entire mkdir lifetime) guarantees that reaching _mkdir_lock_is_stale proves the stamped owner released, so the ceiling only fires on orphans and cannot break genuinely-live owners

The fix applies _mkdir_lock_age_exceeds_ceiling only when current_start is None while preserving immediate reclamation for known-differing start times and never-reclaiming for corroborated live owners
Lock module was refactored from 798 LOC to 510 LOC with a new 339 LOC lock_owner.py sibling to fit the module-size limit and enable the fix
